body:
As far as I know, Godot does not support rendering [texture repeat on different U/V axes](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/246) or specifying different filters for minification and magnification.

Also, I'm curious how this PR handles glTF materials that already specify their own filter/repeat mode. It seems the options only apply on the default sampler right now, but there should probably be a way to force them on materials that specify their own sampler. For example, this could be used to force anisotropic filtering on materials that use a custom sampler, which is probably what I'll personally do the most.

This PR doesn't make any sense for multiple reasons:

* You are overriding the values set in the above `if` statements always, making the `if` statements useless.
* These are settings already specified each texture sampler, so there is no need for these settings in GLTFState.
* The code in GLTFState and GLTFTextureSampler is, for the most part, meant to represent data in the glTF file.
  * If the intention is to override what is specified in the glTF file, that should be done in ResourceImporterScene, as that is where all similar code is, and would support FBX and other formats. And then the settings in ResourceImporterScene would be Godot-specific options.
  * Or, if the intention was to change the defaults, there is already `default_texture_sampler`.
